approval.user_instruction: 算了 还是按你的计划行事 不会影响精度吧 不会就按你的来
approval.scope: Approve execution supplement v1 and the exact synchronized-time-block route; no new FDS run and no lockbox access

parent_protocol.precedence: The approved parent protocol controls every scientific claim and gate; any conflict is a hard stop

scope_and_authority.purpose: Freeze only execution details that are not fully determined by the approved parent protocol
scope_and_authority.approval_rule: The approved file records explicit user approval; every formal runner must verify its exact-byte SHA-256 and the parent-protocol SHA-256 before writing formal output

expansion_trigger.evaluate_from: Outer-fold out-of-fold predictions of the single selected xi-only structure in each fold; never from training residuals or any Pareto candidate chosen after seeing the outer holdout

decision_statistics.standardized_effect_definition: OLS slope on parent-level mean standardized residual multiplied by the observed full-development predictor range
decision_statistics.unique_outer_selection_required: Exactly one leakage-free selected xi-only structure and its held-out predictions for each of 9 outer folds

conditions.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment over the frozen systematic-residual family
conditions.trigger_when: At least one listed predictor has a Holm-adjusted interval excluding zero AND abs(standardized_effect_across_full_design_range) >= 0.25
conditions.source_rule: Reuse the existing systematic-residual gate; do not introduce an unregistered residual test

conditions.trigger_when: The selected xi-only outer-fold predictions fail any applicable approved absolute shape gate

acceptance_rule.must_pass_against_each_comparator: replacement_gate.routes.materially_better from the approved parent protocol
acceptance_rule.failure_action: Discard q/d-dependent shape as a final candidate and retain the best eligible xi-only route or A0 under the parent protocol

trial_budget.trial_definition: One task/campaign x outer/inner stage x frozen seed execution, with one fixed per-seed budget

per_campaign_derivation.inner_search: 9 outer folds * 4 inner folds * 5 outer-search seeds = 180

budget_interpretation: Iteration, candidate-evaluation and wall-time values are independent per-trial ceilings; reaching any one ends that trial
Serial trial-hours are sums of per-trial wall-time ceilings, not elapsed-clock promises and not CPU-core hours
Failed, interrupted, timed-out and no-candidate trials remain in their frozen denominators and receive no replacement seed
The conditional 245 trials may not be spent unless the frozen shape-expansion trigger passes
AI Feynman optional audit and deterministic post-processing are not PySR trials
trial_budget.trial_identity_rule: campaign_id must be part of trial_id so shape_xi_only and shape_xi_q_d can never collide

weak_constraint_ablation.allowed_change: Recompute diagnostic eligibility after removing the directional/shape physical filters designated for the weak-constraint comparison
constraints_that_remain_mandatory: real and finite evaluation on support
identical folds, seeds, raw candidates and refitted constants
weak_constraint_ablation.interpretation: The approved same-budget requirement means the same realized raw search pool; it does not authorize an undefined second stochastic search

deterministic_selection.eligible_pool: Candidates that pass all parent-protocol gates applicable at the current stage
deterministic_selection.primary_metric: full parent-group likelihood on the stage-appropriate training/inner-validation data
unique_tie_break_order: lexicographically smaller NFC-normalized canonical_expression by UTF-8 bytes
lexicographically smaller SHA-256 of the canonical structural template
deterministic_selection.scope: The tie-break is used only after approved primary metrics are numerically tied; it never overrides physical, stability, absolute or replacement gates

template_extraction.source: engine expression AST before numeric coefficient folding
template_extraction.rule: Replace each engine-created ephemeral numeric leaf with a distinct parameter in deterministic prefix traversal order
structural_literals_not_refitted: -1 introduced solely by subtraction or unary negation
0 and 1 introduced solely as algebraic identities
Q_ref, D_ref, H_eff and T0 frozen by the parent protocol
template_extraction.parameter_names: c_0001, c_0002, ...; exponent parameters use p_0001, p_0002, ...

proposed_bounds.positive_scale_parameterization: optimize log(scale) inside the stated physical bounds
proposed_bounds.role_assignment_rule: Use exponent bounds only for registered free exponents; use positive-scale bounds only where the structural domain contract requires that constant to be positive; otherwise use signed-coefficient bounds

proposed_optimizer.start_0: engine estimate projected strictly inside the bounds, or the bound midpoint if unavailable/nonfinite
proposed_optimizer.starts_1_to_31: deterministically scrambled Sobol points in transformed parameter space
proposed_optimizer.sobol_seed: first 32 bits of SHA-256(template_sha256 + '|' + stage_id + '|' + fold_id + '|' + search_seed)
proposed_optimizer.objective: the approved full parent-group likelihood for the current fold/stage

failure_rules.invalid_start: Exception, optimizer failure, nonfinite objective/prediction, or any domain/grammar violation
failure_rules.candidate_refit_unstable: Fewer than two valid starts reproduce the best objective within 1e-6 * max(1, abs(best_objective))
failure_rules.candidate_bound_hit: Any selected constant lies within 1e-6 of its normalized bound width from a bound
failure_rules.freeze_eligibility: FAILED, UNSTABLE or BOUND_HIT candidates are not freeze-eligible
failure_rules.rerun_or_manual_repair: Forbidden; changing bounds, starts, optimizer or template requires a new approved supplement version before inspecting replacement or lockbox results

best_start_tie_break: lower L2 norm of transformed parameter vector
lexicographically smaller full-precision transformed parameter vector

stability_accounting.outer_fold_numerator: For a family, count an outer fold only when that fold's single leakage-free selected structure belongs to the family
stability_accounting.final_seed_numerator: For a core-variable support, count a final seed only when that seed's single selected structure has exactly that support

prediction_equivalence_clustering.pairwise_rule: Both approved RMS and maximum prediction-difference thresholds must pass on the frozen domain audit set
prediction_equivalence_clustering.forbidden_algorithm: connected components or union-find transitive closure of pairwise-equivalence edges
member_order: lexicographically smaller NFC-normalized canonical_expression by UTF-8 bytes
prediction_equivalence_clustering.assignment: Visit members in frozen order; assign to the first existing cluster only if the candidate passes both pairwise thresholds against every current member, otherwise create a new cluster
prediction_equivalence_clustering.multiple_eligible_clusters: Choose the eligible cluster with the earliest representative in the frozen member order; never merge clusters through the new member
prediction_equivalence_clustering.cluster_invariant: Every pair within a prediction-equivalence cluster must directly pass both thresholds
prediction_equivalence_clustering.claim_rule: Prediction-equivalent clusters remain current-domain indistinguishability classes and are never called algebraically identical formulas

g4_fds_evidence_reuse.accepted_scope: The existing G4 records remain the authoritative FDS technical and scientific acceptance for all 27 development runs
g4_fds_evidence_reuse.version_scope: All 27 accepted G4 development runs are the already-approved FDS 6.9.1 evidence set; no new FDS 6.10.1 run may be mixed into this fit
not_repeated_in_g5_sr: restoration of .out, _hrr.csv, .smv or full-field files solely for re-validation
restored_data_checks_still_required: Exact hashes, schemas and row counts of the two frozen G4 derived tables
One-to-one run_chid/job_attempt_id/window_id joins for restored time-series-derived inputs
Readable time coordinates, complete frozen-window coverage and synchronized spatial coordinates
g4_fds_evidence_reuse.interpretation: The remaining checks establish provenance and statistical-input integrity only; they are not a new FDS validation or a new scientific acceptance

construction.source: Original accepted development-run ceiling-temperature samples inside each frozen steady window
construction.method: circular moving source blocks with stride one sample and the per-run frozen bootstrap_block_len_samples

integrity_rules: The identity columns must join one-to-one to the approved development registry and restored G4 tables
The composite key run_chid/job_attempt_id/window_id/time_block_id/x_coord_m must be unique
Every time_block_id within a run must contain the same complete spatial-coordinate set
All positions in one time_block_id must use identical source time indices and block bounds
block_len_samples must equal the corresponding frozen G4 value
No source sample may lie outside the frozen steady window
The manifest must record row count, exact-byte SHA-256, generator hash, source-run hashes and schema validation status

forbid: fabricating blocks from confidence intervals or bootstrap summaries

after_this_supplement_is_approved_and_im: conditional 245-trial shape expansion only if triggered
G5-SR3 grouped out-of-fold evaluation, structural stability and provisional replacement assessment
G5-SR4 diagnostic decision or proposal only; no automatic FDS generation/run

implementation_acceptance_before_formal_: An approved non-draft supplement exists and both protocol hashes are checked before any formal output write
The search planner emits 490 initial trials and at most 735 main-search trials with collision-free campaign-aware IDs
Shape xi_q_d cannot launch without a saved passing trigger artifact
Prediction-equivalence clustering satisfies the all-pairs invariant
Constant-template/refit rules have dedicated deterministic tests
Weak-constraint ablation launches no second stochastic search
SR5 refuses to start without the synchronized-time-block table and manifest
All existing tests pass and the lockbox remains SEALED_UNREAD_UNRUN
